sources.title: Monzo wrongly denied refunds to thousands of fraud and scam victims | Monzo bank | The Guardian
Personal banking service quality – Great Britain | Ipsos

brands.evidence: A recurring UK complaint about Monzo is what happens when something goes wrong

client_claims.text: In one Financial Ombudsman case, a restriction affected a customer's account for four weeks, and Monzo acknowledged it had taken too long to restore full access.
client_claims.note: No fact covers this ombudsman case.

client_claims.text: Of the Monzo fraud and scam complaints the Ombudsman resolved in 2025, it sided with the customer in about a third.
You can pay cash in at a Post Office or PayPoint, but a fee can apply.
client_claims.note: Cash deposit fees are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo ranked first for overall service quality among personal current-account providers in Great Britain in the independent Ipsos survey published in August 2026.
client_claims.note: Ipsos ranking is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Monzo has an app-first model with no branches.
